segments.text: Haruta is the protagonist of the game. Having spent his youth with his mother in Indonesia where she worked as an Indonesian-Japanese translator, he re-moved to Japan some time after the death of his mother or he was adopted by the Kamikawa family. At that time, the family was composed of Michinori, his wife, and Saya (Wakana, who had already left the family home very early because she was in conflict and in total disagreement with her father).

During his childhood, he met Miaya, who soon became his closest friend. During this period of his life, his love feelings began to develop towards Saya. Their feelings came into concordance a year and a half ago or they started dating.

However, seeing their relationship change, Michinori had summoned Haruta and emancipated him, giving him the name of his mother and confessing a harsh truth to him: that he was his biological son and that Saya and he were brother and sister. He then kicked him out and Haruta started living alone in a small apartment near his high school. But that did not mean the beginning of a life of loneliness, because Miaya lives in an apartment near Haruta to take care of him, herself.
This is how the story of our hero begins...

The father of Wakana, Haruta and Saya. Unfaithful husband with many mistresses, more absent than present and very strict. Because of complicated family machinations, Haruta and Saya didn't know that they were bound by the blood, having no mother to prove them the opposite.
Having felt a change of relationship between the siblings, he emancipates his son himself by giving him the family name of his mother and kicking him out of their home.
He is behind the merger project of Souto High School and Houjou High School ever since the sudden death of Souto High School's principal.

He had an affair with his own sister of which he was "in love" and the twins are the fruits of their love. Having feared the social repercussions, they did not live together and the twins were separated, Haruta going to Indonesia with his mother and Saya staying in Japan with her father, her "mother" and her half-sister.

The mother of Haruta, she educated her son alone in Indonesia where she worked as a Japanese-Indonesian translator. She died a few years ago because of a fatal illness just before the arrival of Haruta in Japan.

She was Michinori's little sister and has always been in love with him and was the childhood friend of her brother's current wife. Even though her friend learned the bond they had and the children they had from this affair (Haruta and Saya), they remained friends.

Her friend has never been angry that Yukariko slept with her husband because she knew the loving feelings she felt for him. Her friend even had secretly arranged meetings that Saya could visit Yukariko and Haruta.
Michinori's wife and the mother of Wakana and Saya. She is very loyal and obedient to her husband sometimes to the detriment of her daughters...
She was Yukariko's childhood friend and knew she had love for her brother. However, she was forced to marry Michinori, whom she did not yet know.
She has never been angry that her best friend slept with her husband. She even had secretly arranged meetings for her that Saya could visit Yukariko and Haruta.
